subject: Timberline POC — kickoff, success criteria & milestone owners
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@timberline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Timberline POC — kickoff, success criteria & milestone owners

Hi Alex — great call earlier, thanks for walking through the primary success metrics and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

1) High-level POC scope (what we'll validate)
- Inference throughput at 99th pct latency <= 300ms for 128-token prompts (baseline).
- End-to-end feature parity for Timberline search-assist flow on sample dataset (100k rows).
- Embeddings quality: precision@10 >= 0.75 on your evaluation queries.

2) Proposed timeline (can compress by a week if procurement is fast)
- Week 0 (prep): (Apr 29–30) access & dataset drop, IAM & network checks.
- Week 1 (kickoff + initial integration): May 3–7 — SDK integration, short smoke tests.
- Week 2–3 (validation): May 10–21 — run eval scenarios, run load at target QPS.
- Week 4 (final readout): May 24 — consolidated results, decision meeting.

3) Owners (internal & your side)
- Redwood: Logan (overall lead), Marissa (trial ops & runbook), Priyom (integration engineer).
- Timberline: Alex (product lead), Sasha (data owner), procurement: contracts@timberline.ai.

4) Success criteria (pass / fail gating)
- Latency SLO met in 3 of 4 validation windows.
- Feature parity checklist (15 items) marked >= 80% done.
- Business signal: baseline retrieval precision uplift >= 8 percentage points.

5) Logistics / ask from you
- Confirm ability to share a 100k anonymized sample dataset by Apr 30.
- Confirm SOC2 evidence request (they asked for a copy) — procurement contact is contracts@timberline.ai.
- Kickoff availability: prefer May 4–5 for 60–90m kickoff. Please confirm preferred day/time.

I attached a first-pass SOW and a mutual action plan that maps deliverables to dates (Timberline_POC_SOW_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx). I also sketched evaluation cases you asked about (timberline-eval-cases.md).

If that looks right, we'll lock the kickoff, assign calendar invites, and Marissa will run the mutual-action spreadsheet as the source of truth for weekly check-ins.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Logan Wright
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Timberline_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP milestones), timberline-eval-cases.md (eval scenarios)
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@timberline.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha@timberline.ai>, contracts@timberline.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timberline POC — kickoff, success criteria & milestone owners

Thanks Logan — that recap is helpful and aligns with internal expectations. A couple of notes / tweaks from our side: 

- Timeline: May 3 kickoff is tight for our legal review. Can we target May 5 kickoff and use May 3–4 for final dataset prep and access? That gives procurement two business days to look at SOW and counters if needed.
- Evaluation: add one adversarial prompt set (security/noise) to the eval cases — Sasha will send the set by EOD Tue.
- Data: we can provide a 100k sample but it will be pseudonymized; ETA Apr 30 is fine.
- Compliance: procurement requested SOC2 Type II report and a short answer about data retention on the hosted tier. Sending contracts@ to pull in the right doc owners.
- Stakeholders: please include Prio (integration) in all technical calls. Is Priyom the correct contact?

If you can move the kickoff to May 5 (Tue) at 10:00 PT, Marissa and I will confirm calendar invites. Once procurement confirms, Sasha and I will join the technical slot and Prio/Priyom will be on the integration check.

Subject: Fwd: Timberline POC — kickoff, success criteria & milestone owners

Alex / Sasha — looping in the operational runbook and updated Mutual Action Plan. Per Alex's note, we've moved the kickoff to Tue May 5 at 10:00 PT (calendar pending confirmation from contracts). Highlights from the attached MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx):

- Owners (detailed):
  * Redwood: Logan (exec sponsor), Marissa (POC ops), Priyom (integration lead), Monica (results analyst).
  * Timberline: Alex (product), Sasha (data), contracts@timberline.ai (procurement).

- Weekly cadence (standing):
  * Kickoff (May 5) — 60–90m: scope, access, critical path, success gates.
  * Weekly syncs: Wed 30m standup (status, blockers) + Fri 60m validation deep-dive (shared recordings).
  * Final readout: Mon May 24 (45–60m) — results deck and decision.

- Deliverables & gating dates:
  * Apr 30: dataset delivered + SOC2 doc shared.
  * May 7: SDK integration complete (smoke tests passing).
  * May 21: validation windows complete (all eval runs).
  * May 24: readout & decision.

- Risks: procurement lag (mitigation: Redwood to sign a short mutual NDA to unblock access), dataset format differences (mitigation: sample ingestion script we will share).

I attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (updated with owner columns), Timberline_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW with timing), and timberline-eval-cases.md (added adversarial prompts placeholder). Once contracts confirms, I'll create the MAP as a living Google Sheet and share the Drive link (see related links in thread).

Next asks for Timberline:
- Confirm May 5 kickoff at 10:00 PT.
- Confirm dataset delivery on Apr 30 and SOC2 doc availability.
- Confirm procurement contact will review SOW by EOD Apr 28.

If Alex confirms, I'll send calendar invites and create the recurring weekly syncs.

Thanks,
Marissa
